role: Non-View helper struct that builds the tags chip row and free-text notes field card on the morning results screen; MorningDetailCards.tagsAndNotesSection calls its body directly.
types: TagsAndNotesCard: struct (@MainActor, not a View) — tags + notes card builder
state: TagsAndNotesCard.notes: @Binding String (bound to MorningResultsViewModel.notes via $notes in MorningDetailCards, whose notes binding is $vm.notes at MorningResultsView+CardForwarding.swift:35)

units.does: Card: tags row, divider, notes header and a vertical TextField (3-5 lines) bound to notes, wrapped in zenCard. Editing writes through the binding to the parent's notes state.
units.entry: Not a View: called explicitly as TagsAndNotesCard(...).body from MorningDetailCards.tagsAndNotesSection (MorningResultsView+DetailCards.swift:218); TextField edits are user input

units.does: 'Tags' section label above a horizontal scroll of tag chips.
HStack of one chip per ReadingTag.systemTags.

flags.text: Chip row lists only ReadingTag.systemTags and has no 'more tags' entry, so user custom tags (UserSettings.customTags) cannot be applied on the morning screen, and a custom tag already on the session (vm.selectedTags = Set(session.tags)) is invisible and cannot be removed here. ReadingTagSelector adds a moreTagsButton and TagPickerSheet shows a customTagsSection.
Same horizontal ForEach(ReadingTag.systemTags) TagChip row is built separately in ReadingTagSelector.tagChipRow, HistoryView and TagPickerSheet.systemTagsSection.

units.does: TagChip for the tag, selected when in selectedTags; tap calls onToggleTag(tag).
calls: closure:onToggleTag, set by MorningDetailCards.tagsAndNotesSection (MorningResultsView+DetailCards.swift:222) forwarding to MorningDetailCards.onToggleTag, which MorningResultsView.cards sets to toggleTag (MorningResultsView+CardForwarding.swift:30) → Emuqu/Sources/Views/MorningResultsView+CardForwarding.swift:13

units.does: Sage icon + bold subheadline title row shared by tags and notes headers.
